chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
He who puts himself in conditions of ill-repute should not blame those who entertain bad ideas about him.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to put oneself in positions of suspicion according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) establishes the principle of 'self-inflicted blame' (al-muḥtasil bi-l-lam), noting that while suspicion itself is not inherently sinful, it becomes justified when a person voluntarily exposes themselves to scrutiny through ambiguous behavior. This hadith is frequently cited in Shia jurisprudence and ethics to distinguish between the sin of the observer and the responsibility of the actor, emphasizing that social reputation is a trust that must be guarded with prudence.
